coverageNote: School and RUS statewide record alerts compare reported single-game records in Rural Utah Sports datasets. Team-history alerts require at least 30 completed games and flag completed games ranking in a program’s all-time top five for points scored, largest win, points allowed, or largest loss. UHSAA watch alerts only mean a performance exceeds the mark currently listed in the UHSAA football records book; official recognition may require UHSAA review.
